newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quoted higher on tight supplies.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quoted higher on tight supplies.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes moved slightly higher on Tuesday on tight supplies, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $104-$106 per tonne and 380-cst at above $100 per tonne, $2-$3 higher than Monday's levels. MDO and gas oil were quoted at around $195 and $210 respectively.
Bunker suppliers said they saw improving enquiries. "But I am pretty tight on supplies at the moment," said one major. A trader with an independent said he was only offering the 380-cst grade.
